title: Not consistent with the browning too light, too dark, or both sides aren’t the same!
text:
Not consistent with the browning too light, too dark, or both sides aren’t the same!. I already have a toaster but we like to toast long sour dough bread and thought this would be great I thought!
It would be great, if it only toasted even, and on number two or three it could make toast Too dark, or it will toast pretty good at times!
The ends of the long bread get burned, or it doesn’t , but then the middle is not toasted!
It’s not consistent !

Another problem is, you can Not lift the toaster button up to see how your bread is toasting! That could be a big reason to return this also, cause it’s not toasting consistent.

My other toaster is for 4 regular slices, and it’s a Russell Hobbs that’s not alway the same either but at least I can lift the handle and check the bread. I think that was close
To $100.00, or less!

I also have sitting in my garage a Rollete (not sure on the spelling, but that’s a hand made toaster from England and was about $300.00.
It just shows price doesn’t matter. We just want a toaster that is consistent !
I’m thinking of returning this one!
Or will it get better if we use it more!

I also notice the price on this toaster fluctuates about $ 10.00 more or less with in
Minutes !
I don’t mind paying, but I don’t like being Ripped Off, and nobody should also.

I remember a few years ago I had a black & Decker toaster oven and the toast came out
Perfect every time, and it was $20 something $. But it’s big.

If this toaster keeps working inconsistent in another week it’s going back to Amazon.
But this toaster is good looking, big deal! I would rather have a ugly toaster that works.

2 to 3 stars, maybe.
